# 🐄 Talia \- Farming

Blurb:  
Talis farm is a farm surrounded by a huge stone circle owned by the calm bard Taelisen.

Have the plants get \+1 click a day automatically so people who prefer non-interactive pets can still grow plants. Plus the small pay off for clicks from the produce wont be at a deficit to the amount of clicks needed to get it. Plants however cant be given food. Maybe have fertiliser that increases the click per day to \+2. 

When seeds are used in inventory on they go to the next stage of planted  
When the flowering stage is clicked on it gives 1-3 produce item and 0-1 seed item in inventory.

Maybe have root veg die when you pick it, above ground veg lasts a few times, and the trees and vines circle forever?  
Though really you could have all the veg die when you pick it in one harvest.  
We could also have a 1-2 chance of seeds instead, but people may end up with a huge stockpile of seeds.  
And as said you can also just never pick them and freeze them to keep them forever.

# 🐟 Sunny \- Fishing and Fishing Guild

Blurb  
Trans fisherwoman Sunny with straw sunhat covered in lures sells all fishing equipment giving access to the areas. 

Sunny:  
The fisherwoman was born male to a typical grumpy old fisherman. Brought up doing nothing but fishing, and gutting fish for the other fishermen he lived in a world of drab wooden boards, grey water, and greyer fish. Looking to get away one day he started wandering into town, against his father's wishes. Eventually he got as far as the theatre district which finally brought light and colour to his world. There was no rules, and more importantly, no fish. He lived there for a while slowly discovering and finding herself in the safety of the theatre lights. However one day she got a letter that turned her newfound world upside down. Her father had died. This meant she now needed to run the fishing docks and shop. So sadly she packed up her bags and moved back into the dull fishing shop. It was in such stark contrast to the theatre district she couldn't bare it and soon started changing the shop to be a more vibrant and inviting place. The other grouchy fisherman weren't too fond of what was going on, but as the bubbly woman was obviously far better at social interactions than the stone eyed old fisherman they soon found the docks busy with new clients and customers. Eventually it was as if it had always been this way. However although she still hated carving up the fish, she did quite like them alive. So she came up with a no harm capture system for the fish who weren't caught just for food.

*Have a subtle trans reference with a pink fish jumping across a blue and a white wave on a flag in the background.*

# Ruinily \- Event and beginner shop

## Voice lines:

The shopkeeper.png is just a small dialogue box I presume shown when they're talking? I'd rather just have their head, it's less work.

Welcome line:  
‘Hello\! Please take a look around, I'll be here if you need anything.’

Intro:   
‘Welcome to my little shop of oddities, how are you feeling? You can take a seat over there until you catch your breath, it can be disorientating at first. Just be careful with the items  around you. I stock whatever I can from rare decorations to useful spells, if you break it you either buy it or you may be get cursed. I regularly change stock for events and goings on so keep checking back, you never know when something you need might catch your eye. If you dont mind helping out I have a few lost butterflycat kittens in the back who need good owners. I also dont mind taking things off your hands if you want some extra gems, I presume you wont have many on you since you just arrived. Just let me know if you need anything, alright?’

Flavour Texts:  
‘Have you seen anything you like yet? Have you tried in that corner?’   
‘Try not to touch anything, some of the items wont like it.’  
‘Those butterflykittens are not good with the stock... If you know anyone who wants one please take one.’ 

Also Ruinilys 'intro' wont actually be her intro since she introduces the player to the world in after the cutscene. That's what that full body shot is for. She'll introduce herself there, explain the person fell through a dimensional hole, and ask them to follow her to her shop if they want to take a moment to recover. And then try and sell them stuff because she's merciless. This 'intro' is after that.

## 

## Pets

Usiagi \-   
Shop description:   
A pink egg gently wrapped in soft fluff.   
Pet Description:   
‘These rare serpentine felines only appear briefly during certain times, usually with a new fur colour. They are egg layers but the young and adults are incredibly easy to take care of as long as they're kept warm. Their nature takes more from the feline side as these lap sized carnivores are playful in bursts, but more commonly lazy. Since they are cuddly warmth seekers who will curl their soft, fluffy body around their owner and nap for hours they are popular among collectors.’

Fyrilarch \-   
Shop description:   
A box sheltering a shy creature.   
Pet Description:   
‘The Fyrilarch, (more commonly known as the butterflycat), can often be seen flitting and soaring through the sky above in large numbers, although there are rumours of more unusual kinds of Fyrilarch hiding out there. Due to how common they are the felines are used as the cities mascot, carving and symbols of them can be found everywhere. Despite being everywhere they are still very shy and will typically fly away from anyone who approaches them. They are slightly smaller than the average cat, and despite looking like one they can easily be held in one hand due to how light they are. These winged cats are avid hunters who mostly survive off insects in the wild, but they will nibble most things in tiny portions, ironically making them perfect companions for people who arent fond of insects. The rest of thier time is spent sunbathing with thier wings lazily flapping in the warmth.’

Broken Statue \-   
Shop description:  
A broken black and white statue.   
Pet Description:   
‘No one is entirely sure where these statues came from, (there are many rumours of haunted pottery factories thanks to these statues), or why they are always found broken, but despite this mystery they seem harmless enough to sell when they appear on shop shelves. They manifest as ceramic shards with black on one side and white on the other. Anyone with the patience to fix one will find one colour appearing on the outside and the other on the inside, interestingly the shape of the statue seems to depend on which colour is on the outside. If black it will take the shape of a black horse with red eyes. If white it will take the shape of an elegant white dog. Do not be alarmed, once completed the statue will come to life, though it rarely responds to anything. The enchanted porcelain will move as if its actions are programmed. Although some claim the demonic horse is unlucky while the angelic dog is lucky there has been no actual proof.’

# Erishik'nyang \- Mind Guild

Blurb:  
The name Ershik'nyangl floats around a tricky man no one has ever fully seen. Pass his puzzles to be in the guild.

Erishik'nyangl:  
A psychic alien cat called Erishik'nyangl crashed on the mountain above and abandoned the craft as they were carrying precious cargo that was more important. A batch of eggs containing their offspring. Quickly studying the inhabitants below they deemed a few possibly worthy of being 'host' to them. Unlike movie aliens these cute furballs only need the aura of vibrant brainwaves to grow healthy and strong. So hiding behind a mysterious looking trenchcoat and hat they set up the mentalist guild to attract the right sort of host, give tests to test their brainwaves, and any that succeed are rewarded with a new cosmic companion. However they take so long to reach the adult stage Erish is in you will likely never see it.

# Konro Bar \- Drinks & Void pet

Blurb:  
A shady bar owned by Konro the air bender, ex-assassin.

Konro:   
A cheery looking, smartly dressed male stands behind the bar casually cleaning a glass. Despite the smiling face there’s a almost unnerving sharpness behind the icy blue eyes. However if you talk to him you’ll find yourself in for an entertaining night as the charismatic male spins many tales about his adventures while showing off his ability to make things hover and fly. If you’re brave enough to glance at the bar patrons that know him they seem either very sketchy or to have the same cloak of humour. 

Being another person who was dropped into this strange land from one that was possibly stranger Konro took some unsavoury jobs, utilising his unique ability to control the air around him to make a living. Even though he became entangled in the more dangerous parts of the city he was known to have a sense of honour, mostly going after people who some would say deserved their fate. This almost vigilante behaviour gave him a second chance at a better life as he was offered a position at a remote bar. The dimensional walls are particularly weak in this area with portals sneakily opening and closing all over the place. So he was asked to defend the area in case anything dangerous came through, but all that slipped through the portals were seemingly harmless pests that slithered about in the void between dimensions. For now he sells drinks and the weird void creatures while defending the bar from anything that would attack it.

# Post Office

Post office: Could be used to send DMs in a Animal Crossing like way (pick a card background, type a message and send it) to add friction to dming by making it a bigger deal. Will likely be used just for celebrations/trade messages, which is easier to scan though. Could also have set words or phrases such as 'happy birthday\!' And 'I would like to trade 'select pet/item ID here' for 'select pet/item ID here'.   
Postcard backgrounds could also be earned by completing travel mini puzzles such as packing a bag or planning a flight. If we do have stickers people could get postcards of the country by scanning the sticker in the country.  
Likely the dm part would be part of the base game and the post cards would be rolled out much later.

# Item design

Game design thought: Have the background box behind items gifs coloured depending on the items category. Such as grey for random rubbish that can only be sold, green for seeds that can be planted, blue for fish when they get fished out, yellow for stickers, ect.  
Then as soon as the person gets the item they know what it is and what it can do.   
Same idea as the tiny icons on items on the pixel cat site, but more intuitive and less invasive as colours use general game drop colours.

ITEMS \= ID, name(not player given), type(food, jewellery, decorative, ect), value(value when eaten/value when sold), picture \- options: sell/eat, throw away/delete, rubbish tip to recycle

PETS \= ID, name(player given), species, owner(link to their profile so they can show off if someone clicked on the pet from a different site), birthday, click count/level, Mood if you want to use it? \- options: put up for adoption, release/delete, stop aging (basic feature, people like collecting forever puppies and kittens, or the entire family art with male, female, young, and frozen eggs. It's something we do.)

PLANTS \= ID, name(player given), name of plant(strawberry, orange tree, ect, like species), owner, how long it's been growing for, clicks(clicks eventually give produce) \- Options: sell, plant in the wild/delete, rubbish tip?

FISH \- ID, name(player given), name of fish(fish breed), owner, date caught, size (if you want to add a number randomiser for some fun) \- options: sell, release/delete

'Features

Mysidia Adoptables is a proud product from Mysidia Inc., owned by Hall of Famer. Hall of Famer took over the development of this adoptables script back in Mid-January 2011, and a huge number of new features have been worked on since then. With Mysidia Adoptables, you can create a highly customized adoptables site with click-based level up system. Main features of Mysidia Adoptables are listed below:

\------Simple Installation and site configuration, together with a basic admin control panel to manage adoptables, users and more  
\------Adoptables Creation with primary/alternative outcomes, levels, adoptables pricing and more  
\------Users Registration, Usergroups and usergroup-based Permissions  
\------Custom pages creation in admin control panel with protected/private pages possible  
\------customizable dropdown navlinks and sidebar modules  
\------Advanced Style/Theme Management in which admins can generate styles/css from ACP easily  
\------Upload and use supported image formats (JPG, GIF and PNG) on your site

\------A shoutbox that allows your members to discuss your site  
\------Power Trade System, users can create various types of trade offers while admins have full control over trades.  
\------Powerful Breeding System, admins can make as many flexible rules about the conditions and outcomes for breeding

\------Well-established Friends/Friendlist system

\------Items/inventories and basic item functions with ACP integration  
\------Itemshop and AdoptShop available for users to purchase goods  
\------CKEditor available for private messages, shoutbox and admin creating pages/articles

\------Turn Features/Sub-systems on/off in ACP

# Battle systems

Battle systems

Health system:  
Has health bar that is lowered by attacks, the basis of most battling systems. Refer to pokemon.  
Stamina system:  
Health would be called stamina basically, but moves could be things that tired out opponents instead of killing them.  
Defense system:  
Would be lowering a shield or defenses instead of health or stamina. Would change moves to reflect this.  
Intimidation system:  
Got to scare the opponent off, the least contact version of this system.  
Contest system:  
Would compete with moves that are focua on showing off, or points for doing/having good things like in a cat show.  
Dodge system:  
Got to press a button to dodge incoming attacks, and a button to attack when there's an opening.

General notes:  
Would likely use the click amount to add onto the attack.

If using a system that just has a single attack per pet we could link an element to each pet and use the element circle I made.  
So if the owlbee was nature it would be strong against water and weak against fire, so the strategy would just be using the right element.
